name: jfred
description: Reconstruct file change history from Claude Code session JSONL files (clean-room).

scripts.demo: npm run build:webapp && tar -xf demo/repo.git.tar -C demo/projects/s87-demo-composite && tsx src/viewer_server.ts --projects-dir demo/projects --file-history-dir demo/file-history
scripts.demo:baseline: npm run build:webapp && tar -xf demo-baseline/repo.git.tar -C demo-baseline/projects/baseline-demo && tsx src/viewer_server.ts --projects-dir demo-baseline/projects --file-history-dir demo-baseline/file-history
